result:
Round 93 is planned and the decision is **CONTINUE**. No app source was touched: `store/` is still clean at `64e12d8` and all 518 entries in the new frozen list match.

**Round 92 result:** C passed it with real-browser checks, 0 bugs, and the gate published it as `64e12d8`. That finishes SRW-21 stage 1. The demo `/studio-lab` output is unchanged in the browser. The purchased path is covered only by unit tests, because mounting the purchased route still needs the auth owner's release. I updated the backlog only from that evidence.

**Round 93 (D-29z58): first part of the Low-bug batch, all in the export dialog.** One owner (A), one code file plus one new test file. It fixes three related Low bugs:
- **GATE91-S1 + A-R86-L7:** a screen reader currently reads each format option's note as part of its name. On the disabled range option, the reason is read twice. The fix gives each option a short name and moves the note into the description (`aria-labelledby` + `aria-describedby`). The visible text, classes and test IDs stay byte-identical, so no existing test needs editing; I checked that no snapshot tests exist.
- **A-R86-L8:** the silence and Master-mute notes say "WAV შეიქმნება" even when MP3 is selected. They will now follow the selected format: `WAV` / `MP3` / `WAV და MP3 შეიქმნება`. The WAV text does not change.
- **Tests:** a new test file with exact name, description and text checks (AN1–AN6, NC1–NC3), plus mutation proofs a–h. A must run the code-reviewer, since the round changes 4 files.
- **C's browser checks:** the main check reads the real Chrome accessibility tree at both viewports and in three dialog states. C also checks the notes for each format and re-tests layout, keyboard, export, network and hydration behaviour. One case may not be reachable in a browser: a project with no audible clip. C will try a local silent video; if that fails, the row is reported as unit-tested only, not as a browser pass.

**Why this and not T12:**
- C has no open bugs.
- The regression round is due from 2026-10-24.
- The only remaining core item, the purchased-route mount, is blocked on the auth owner.
- The approved order puts the Low bugs before the full regression and T12.

Round 94 will be the regression round if it is planned on or after 2026-10-24. Otherwise it is Low batch part 2: three load-status and test-gap Lows (COLLECTION-EMPTY-STATUS, GATE92-S1, GATE92-S2). After that come the remaining Lows, then the full regression (R21-I2), T12 and VISUAL-A-OBSIDIAN. Scope is not reduced.

**Signals I recorded but did not schedule:**
- Four new items from the round-92 reviewer and C. The token-in-devtools item (GATE92-S4) is now a prerequisite for the purchased mount.
- An architecture note, added to the pending checkpoint request as q14 (f). Root has still not answered the q14 checkpoint request; it doesn't block anything, so I didn't send it again.
- The MP3/export check in the production bundle (PROD-MP3-UNVERIFIED) is still open; I asked root again to cover it in gate 93.

**Advisor:** available. I consulted it before writing and again at the end. The second review led to three task fixes: the code-reviewer is now required, the WAV description string is written out exactly, and C's leak-check pattern is printed literally below the table.
